echo_sets.name: Tidebreaking Courage
echo_sets.note: Needs 250% Energy Regen for the full bonus: 15% ATK and 30% all-attribute DMG, on top of Brant's own ER-to-ATK conversion. Dragon of Dirge adds 12% Fusion and 12% Basic Attack DMG.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Up to 40% Fusion DMG with no Energy Regen requirement; Game8's recommendation when Unflickering Valor is unavailable.

echo_sets.name: Tidebreaking Courage + Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen plus Fusion DMG while farming a full 5-piece set.

build.energy_regen_target: 250% minimum for the 5-pc Tidebreaking Courage bonus; 280% maximizes the Forte ATK conversion (per Prydwen)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Unflickering Valor + 5-piece Tidebreaking Courage in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Dragon of Dirge in the main slot. Brant converts Energy Regen into ATK, so hit 250% Energy Regen first, then stack Crit Rate/DMG and Basic Attack DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Unflickering Valor
ranked_weapons.note: Signature; huge Energy Regen substat (77% per Prydwen) plus Crit Rate and Basic Attack DMG — what makes the 250% Energy Regen Tidebreaking Courage build possible.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star sword with a Crit Rate substat; solid stat stick whose skill also grants Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's pick for non-ER options; stacks Basic Attack DMG, which Brant scales with.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: Strong raw stats for Brant; Game8 recommends pairing it with Molten Rift.

ranked_weapons.name: Overture
ranked_weapons.note: Budget Energy Regen option that also restores 8 Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill.

stat_priorities.note: Two Energy Regen 3-costs is standard without the signature weapon; one can become Fusion DMG with strong ER rolls and Unflickering Valor.

profile.role_note: Fusion sub-DPS with heals and shields; can flex to Main DPS in quickswap or Mono-Fusion setups.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: An expensive but versatile Fusion sub-DPS with real damage, heals, and shields — a great fit for Fusion teams (especially with Lupa), but his best build nearly requires his signature weapon, so think twice before investing.

members.name: Encore
members.note: On-field Fusion carry; benefits from Brant's Fusion DMG and Resonance Skill DMG Outro buffs.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Hyper-support for Fusion teams; Game8 calls Brant her natural partner for Mono Fusion.

members.name: Brant
members.note: Sub-DPS with heals and shields; 250% Energy Regen converts into massive ATK.

teams.name: Mono Fusion: Encore + Lupa + Brant
teams.rotation: Lupa runs her Fusion buff rotation, Brant drops his Liberation and Outros for the Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG amps, then Encore takes the field for her combo window.

members.name: Changli
members.note: Fusion sword duelist; a documented strong partner for Brant's quickswap rotations.

members.name: Brant
members.note: Flexible hybrid; weaves mid-air combos between teammates and can step up as the main damage dealer.

teams.name: Quickswap: Changli + Brant + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Brant and Changli swap frequently for quickswap damage while Shorekeeper sustains and buffs; Brant's Outro hands off Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG amps to the next carry.

tier_badge.label: Strong
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates Brant A overall (S as Sub-DPS and in Tower of Adversity); Beebom's 3.7 tier list also places him in A.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete hybrid kit. S2 is the clear best-value stop; S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full heal/shield/buff hybrid kit works at S0.
